Law (muloiwa_2020_free_laws eq 11):
  \mu=\mu_{max}\frac{S}{K_{s}+S}\exp\left(-\frac{S}{K_{I}}\right)
  as transcribed: mu = mumax * S_ / (Ks + S_) * exp(-S_ / KI)
Law variables to map:
  S_: Substrate concentration [?]
  mu: Specific bacteria growth rate [1 / s]   <- the quantity the law computes
Law parameters (not mapped): KI, Ks, mumax

Model symbols (the rate symbol is r):
  r: specific rate in the biomass and substrate balance equations [1 / h]
  u1: dilution factor [1 / h]
  u2: substrate concentration in the feed [g / l]
  x1: measured concentration [g / l]
  x2: substrate concentration [g / l]

answer.note: S_ is substrate concentration, matching x2. mu is the specific growth rate, matching r; the law gives it in 1/s while the model uses 1/h, so convert the time units when using the law.
